#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> boundaries;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < s.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] != s[i - 1]) {
            boundaries.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    boundaries.push_back(s.length());
    int count = 0;
    int start = 0;
    for (int end : boundaries) {
        if (((end - start) & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        start = end;
    }
    cout << count;
    return 0;
}
